1.sahih_international: I swear by this city, Makkah -
1.pickthall: Nay, I swear by this city -
1.yusuf_ali: I do call to witness this City;-
1.shakir: Nay! I swear by this city.
1.muhammad_sarwar: I do not (need to) swear by this town (Mecca)
1.arberry: No! I swear by this land,

2.sahih_international: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
2.pickthall: And thou art an indweller of this city -
2.yusuf_ali: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
2.shakir: And you shall be made free from obligation in this city--
2.muhammad_sarwar: in which you are now living
2.mohsin_khan: And you are free (from sin, to punish the enemies of Islam on the Day of the conquest) in this city (Makkah).
2.arberry: and thou art a lodger in this land;

3.sahih_international: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
3.pickthall: And the begetter and that which he begat,
3.yusuf_ali: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
3.shakir: And the begetter and whom he begot.
3.muhammad_sarwar: or by the great father and his wonderful son (Abraham and Ishmael)
3.mohsin_khan: And by the begetter (i.e. Adam) and that which he begot (i.e. his progeny);
3.arberry: by the begetter, and that he begot,

4.sahih_international: We have certainly created man into hardship.
4.pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
4.yusuf_ali: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
4.shakir: Certainly We have created man to be in distress.
4.muhammad_sarwar: that We have created the human being to face a great deal of hardship.
4.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have created man in toil.
4.arberry: indeed, We created man in trouble.

5.sahih_international: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
5.pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
5.yusuf_ali: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
5.shakir: Does he think that no one has power over him?
5.muhammad_sarwar: Does He think that no one will ever have control over him?
5.mohsin_khan: Thinks he that none can overcome him?
5.arberry: What, does he think none has power over him,

6.sahih_international: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
6.pickthall: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
6.yusuf_ali: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
6.shakir: He shall say: I have wasted much wealth.
6.muhammad_sarwar: (He boasts and shows off) saying, "I have spent a great deal of money (for the cause of God)".
6.mohsin_khan: He says (boastfully): "I have wasted wealth in abundance!"

7.sahih_international: Does he think that no one has seen him?
7.pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
7.yusuf_ali: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
7.shakir: Does he think that no one sees him?
7.muhammad_sarwar: Does he think that no one has seen him?
7.mohsin_khan: Thinks he that none sees him?
7.arberry: What, does he think none has seen him?

8.sahih_international: Have We not made for him two eyes?
8.pickthall: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
8.yusuf_ali: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
8.shakir: Have We not given him two eyes,
8.muhammad_sarwar: Have We not given him two eyes,
8.mohsin_khan: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?
8.arberry: Have We not appointed to him two eyes,

9.sahih_international: And a tongue and two lips?
9.pickthall: And a tongue and two lips,
9.yusuf_ali: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
9.shakir: And a tongue and two lips,
9.mohsin_khan: And a tongue and a pair of lips?
9.arberry: and a tongue, and two lips,

10.sahih_international: And have shown him the two ways?
10.pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
10.yusuf_ali: And shown him the two highways?
10.shakir: And pointed out to him the two conspicuous ways?
10.muhammad_sarwar: Have We not shown him the ways of good and evil?
10.mohsin_khan: And shown him the two ways (good and evil)?
10.arberry: and guided him on the two highways?

11.sahih_international: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
11.pickthall: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
11.yusuf_ali: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
11.shakir: But he would not attempt the uphill road,
11.muhammad_sarwar: Yet, he has not entered into Aqaba
11.mohsin_khan: But he has made no effort to pass on the path that is steep.
11.arberry: Yet he has not assaulted the steep;

12.sahih_international: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
12.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
12.yusuf_ali: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
12.shakir: And what will make you comprehend what the uphill road is?
12.muhammad_sarwar: Would that you knew what Aqaba is!
12.mohsin_khan: And what will make you know the path that is steep?
12.arberry: and what shall teach thee what is the steep?

13.sahih_international: It is the freeing of a slave
13.shakir: (It is) the setting free of a slave,
13.muhammad_sarwar: It is the setting free of a slave

14.sahih_international: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
14.pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger.
14.yusuf_ali: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
14.shakir: Or the giving of food in a day of hunger
14.muhammad_sarwar: or, in a day of famine, the feeding of
14.mohsin_khan: Or giving food in a day of hunger (famine),
14.arberry: or giving food upon a day of hunger

15.yusuf_ali: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
15.mohsin_khan: To an orphan near of kin.
15.arberry: to an orphan near of kin

16.sahih_international: Or a needy person in misery
16.pickthall: Or some poor wretch in misery,
16.yusuf_ali: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
16.shakir: Or to the poor man lying in the dust.
16.muhammad_sarwar: and downtrodden destitute person, (so that he would be of)
16.mohsin_khan: Or to a Miskin (poor) afflicted with misery.
16.arberry: or a needy man in misery;

17.sahih_international: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
17.pickthall: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
17.yusuf_ali: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
17.shakir: Then he is of those who believe and charge one another to show patience, and charge one another to show compassion.
17.muhammad_sarwar: the believers who cooperate with others in patience (steadfastness) and kindness.
17.mohsin_khan: Then he became one of those who believed, and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and (also) recommended one another to pity and compassion.
17.arberry: then that he become of those who believe and counsel each other to be steadfast, and counsel each other to be merciful.

18.sahih_international: Those are the companions of the right.
18.pickthall: Their place will be on the right hand.
18.yusuf_ali: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
18.shakir: These are the people of the right hand.
18.muhammad_sarwar: These are the people of the right hand.
18.mohsin_khan: They are those on the Right Hand (the dwellers of Paradise),
18.arberry: Those are the Companions of the Right Hand.

19.sahih_international: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
19.pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
19.yusuf_ali: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
19.shakir: And (as for) those who disbelieve in our communications, they are the people of the left hand.
19.muhammad_sarwar: As for those who disbelieve in Our revelations, they are the people of the left
19.mohsin_khan: But those who disbelieved in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell).
19.arberry: And those who disbelieve in Our signs, they are the Companions of the Left Hand;

20.sahih_international: Over them will be fire closed in.
20.pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them.
20.yusuf_ali: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
20.shakir: On them is fire closed over.
20.muhammad_sarwar: who will be engulfed in the fire.
20.mohsin_khan: The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.
20.arberry: over them is a Fire covered down.
